Class AsyncBatchWriteBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractBatchWriteBuilder<T, AsyncBatchWriteBuilder<T>>
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.async.AsyncBatchWriteBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
public class AsyncBatchWriteBuilder<T> extends AbstractBatchWriteBuilder<T, AsyncBatchWriteBuilder<T>>
Builds an async batch write operation to put and delete multiple items in a single table.

Obtain via AsyncTable.batchWrite(). Executes using the async enhanced client and returns a CompletableFuture that completes with the batch write result.

A single batch write can contain up to 25 put and delete operations combined. Unprocessed items are automatically retried with exponential backoff (up to 3 retries).

    • execute

      public @NonNull CompletableFuture<BatchWriteResult> execute()
      Executes the batch write operation asynchronously.

      All puts and deletes added to this builder are sent in a single batch write request. Unprocessed items are automatically retried with exponential backoff (up to 3 retries).

      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture containing the BatchWriteResult
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if more than 25 items (puts + deletes combined) are provided
